priority_groups.description: Priority 1: Configuration and client-side signal/query helpers

tests.name: config_loads_domain_defaults_from_json_file
tests.description: Load default domain, task list, target, and timeout values from domain-task-list-retry-config.json
tests.arrange: Point config loader at repo's domain-task-list-retry-config.json
tests.assert: Returns domain='story-analysis', task_list='story-analysis', cadence_target='localhost:7833', and escalation_timeout_seconds=300

tests.name: config_allows_overrides_and_environment_fallback
tests.description: Config values can be overridden and fall back to environment variables when file is missing
tests.arrange: Provide overrides and unset config file path
tests.assert: Returned config uses provided overrides and falls back to defaults for missing fields

tests.name: signals_send_human_response_with_valid_decision_calls_client_signal_workflow
tests.description: send_human_response encodes the decision and notes and calls client.signal_workflow
tests.arrange: Create a FakeClient that records signal_workflow calls
tests.act: Call send_human_response(client, 'wf-1', 'retry', notes='focus on edge cases')
tests.assert: client.signal_workflow was awaited with workflow_id='wf-1', run_id='', signal_name='human_response', and args ('retry', 'focus on edge cases')

tests.name: signals_rejects_unknown_decision
tests.description: Only retry, accept, and abort are valid human_response decisions
tests.assert: Raises ValueError before calling the client

tests.name: queries_get_status_calls_client_query_workflow
tests.description: get_status queries the StoryAnalysisWorkflow's get_status query
tests.arrange: Create a FakeClient that returns a canned status dict
tests.assert: client.query_workflow was awaited with workflow_id='wf-1', run_id='', query_type='get_status', result_type=dict and the canned dict is returned

tests.name: starter_starts_story_analysis_workflow_with_defaults
tests.description: start_story_analysis_workflow starts StoryAnalysisWorkflow with the story document and default config
tests.arrange: Create a FakeClient and use a test config
tests.assert: client.start_workflow was awaited with workflow_type='StoryAnalysisWorkflow', args=(story_document, config), task_list='story-analysis', execution_start_to_close_timeout=timedelta(hours=1), and workflow_id_reuse_policy=RejectDuplicate

tests.name: starter_generates_deterministic_workflow_id_from_story_path
tests.description: When workflow_id is omitted, derive a stable id from the story document path
tests.arrange: Create a FakeClient and a story path
tests.assert: The generated workflow_id is deterministic and contains a sanitized form of the story path

tests.name: starter_accepts_explicit_workflow_id_and_config_overrides
tests.description: Operator can override workflow_id, domain, task list, and timeout
tests.act: Call start_story_analysis_workflow with explicit workflow_id and config overrides
tests.assert: client.start_workflow uses the provided workflow_id and timeout

tests.name: cli_start_subcommand_invokes_starter_and_prints_execution
tests.description: The 'start' subcommand parses arguments and calls start_story_analysis_workflow
tests.arrange: Patch starter and create a FakeClient context manager
tests.assert: starter was called with the story document and workflow_id; output includes workflow_id and run_id

tests.name: cli_signal_subcommand_invokes_send_human_response
tests.description: The 'signal' subcommand sends a human_response signal
tests.arrange: Patch send_human_response and create a FakeClient context manager
tests.assert: send_human_response was called with workflow_id='wf-1', decision='accept', notes='Looks good'

tests.name: cli_query_subcommand_invokes_get_status_and_prints_json
tests.description: The 'query' subcommand queries workflow status and prints JSON
tests.arrange: Patch get_status to return a dict and create a FakeClient context manager
tests.assert: get_status was called with workflow_id='wf-1' and printed JSON matches the dict

tests.name: cli_register_domain_subcommand_registers_the_domain
tests.description: The 'register-domain' subcommand calls the Cadence RegisterDomain gRPC endpoint
tests.arrange: Create a FakeClient with a domain_stub that records RegisterDomain calls
tests.assert: domain_stub.RegisterDomain was awaited with name='story-analysis' and retention period of 3 days

tests.name: cli_exits_with_error_on_unknown_subcommand
tests.description: The CLI prints help and exits non-zero for unknown subcommands
tests.assert: SystemExit is raised with a non-zero exit code

tests.name: client_api_round_trip_start_signal_query_uses_consistent_defaults
tests.description: A full client interaction uses the same domain, task list, and signal/query names across modules
tests.arrange: Create a FakeClient capturing all calls
tests.act: Call starter, send_human_response, and get_status using default config
tests.assert: All calls reference domain from config, signal_name='human_response', query_type='get_status', and workflow_type='StoryAnalysisWorkflow'
